definition: A neural network whose topology is fixed by the connectome and whose biophysical parameters are learned through task optimization

key_structural_ingredients.description: Network wiring follows fib25-fib19_v2.2 connectome exactly (65 cell types, 605 edges)
key_structural_ingredients.status: verified from checkpoint and connectome file

key_structural_ingredients.description: Leaky integrator neurons with ReLU activation, parameterized by per-type bias and time constant
Resting potential (per type), time constant (per type), synaptic strength (per type pair), synaptic sign (fixed from literature)
key_structural_ingredients.status: verified from checkpoint structure: nodes_bias(65), nodes_time_const(65), edges_sign(604), edges_syn_strength(604)

key_structural_ingredients.description: Synapse counts from connectome are not learned (requires_grad=false)
End-to-end training on optic flow estimation (MPI Sintel) with L2 norm loss
